author: dimos/crew/ace
text:
## Network Validation Results (2026-02-18)

### Topology Confirmed
- **GOS (104)**: 10.21.31.104 — SSH via Tailscale at m20-770-gogo (user@), our entry point
- **AOS (103)**: 10.21.31.103 — Motion control, UDP:30000, RTSP:8554, ROS2 topics
- GOS to AOS ping: sub-2ms on internal 10.21.31.0/24 LAN
- Mac to AOS: NOT reachable (no direct WiFi connection)
- Mac to GOS: via Tailscale only (~100ms RTT)

### Services on GOS (104)
- m20-relay: ACTIVE (v0.2.0, ROS connected)
- go2rtc: ACTIVE (front+rear streams configured)

### Services on AOS (103) - currently all INACTIVE
- basic_server: INACTIVE (UDP command handler)
- multicast-relay: INACTIVE (needed for /LIDAR/POINTS)
- rl_deploy: INACTIVE (needed for motion)
- planner: INACTIVE (built-in planner)

### ROS2 Topics Visible from GOS
50+ topics including:
- /NAV_CMD (drdds/msg/NavCmd) — 0 pubs, 1 sub — VELOCITY INPUT FOR NAV MODE
- /MOTION_INFO (drdds/msg/MotionInfo) — 1 pub, 3 subs — actual velocities at 20Hz
- /ODOM — ONBOARD ODOMETRY EXISTS
- /tf — ROBOT PUBLISHES OWN TRANSFORMS
- /LIDAR/POINTS (sensor_msgs/msg/PointCloud2) — 1 pub, 1 sub
- /IMU (sensor_msgs/msg/Imu) — 1 pub, 2 subs

### DDS Middleware
- M20 uses ros-foxy-fastrtps (NOT CycloneDDS)
- OS: Ubuntu 20.04 Focal, ROS2 Foxy
- Custom pkg: drdds-ros2-msgs v1.0.4

### CRITICAL ARCHITECTURE ISSUES
1. UDP axis commands ONLY work in Regular Mode (dev guide 1.2.5). Our connection.py switches to Navigation Mode then sends velocity via UDP - THIS WILL NOT WORK. Must use /NAV_CMD DDS topic.
2. Our lidar.py uses CycloneDDS Python but M20 uses FastRTPS. Need to test interop or switch to rclpy.
3. /ODOM and /tf exist onboard - dead-reckoning odometry is unnecessary.
4. /MOTION_INFO gives actual velocities - better source for odometry than integrating commands.
5. dimos needs to run on GOS (104) for direct access, or use relay as bridge from Mac.

author: dimos/crew/ace
text: Live-tested on real M20 via WiFi→GOS (ee321cdca, c232a5b15): /LIDAR/POINTS→/ALIGNED_POINTS, fixed MotionInfo accessor, agile gait 0x3002 for Nav Mode, QoS depth=10, planner conflict warning. 47/47 tests passing. All 5 ROS topics confirmed active.
